name: trmv
signature: void trmv(long n, const double *L, const double *x, double *y)
layout: L is an n x n matrix stored row-major: element (i, j) is at index i*n + j. Only the lower triangle of L, including the diagonal (j <= i), is part of the matrix; the entries above the diagonal hold arbitrary values and must be ignored. x and y have n elements. y is output only and its initial contents are undefined. No two arrays overlap. n is at least 1.
